```{r ERGM, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(statnet)
library(ergm)
library(mice)

#PULL OUT THE COLUMNES WE NEED
elist2 <- elist %>% 
           select(c(ID, FRIEND, LIKE))

#CREATE NETWORK OBJECT
net <- network(elist2,matrix.type="edgelist", directed=FALSE)

#symmetrize the network and rebuild
net_strong <- symmetrize(net,rule="strong") #only include cases when BOTH nominate, returns adjacency matrix
net_strong <- network(net_strong,matrix.type="adjacency", directed=FALSE) 
summary(net_strong, print.adj = FALSE) #CHECK THE NETWORK-SHOULD HAVE 213 VERTICES

```

```{r Data Attachment}
#attach attributes to network object from imputated datasets
net_strong%v%"RWA" <- as.numeric(NAI$RWA)
net_strong%v%"SDO" <- as.numeric(NAI$SDO)
net_strong%v%"PAT" <- as.numeric(NAI$PAT)
net_strong%v%"ENV" <- as.numeric(NAI$ENV)
net_strong%v%"IMM" <- as.numeric(NAI$IMM)
net_strong%v%"IAP" <- as.numeric(NAI$IAP)
net_strong%v%"SAP" <- as.numeric(NAI$SAP)
net_strong%v%"Trump" <- as.numeric(NAI$Trump)
net_strong%v%"Obama" <- as.numeric(NAI$Obama)
net_strong%v%"Gender" <- as.character(NAI$Gender)
net_strong%v%"Grade" <- as.character(NAI$Grade)
net_strong%v%"Income" <- as.numeric(NAI$income)
net_strong%v%"pedu" <- as.numeric(NAI$pedu)
net_strong%v%"RWH" <- as.character(NAI$Race_1)
net_strong%v%"ETH" <- as.character(NAI$Ethnicity)
net_strong%v%"RWA_A" <- as.numeric(NAI$RWA_A)
net_strong%v%"RWA_C" <- as.numeric(NAI$RWA_C)
net_strong%v%"RWA_T" <- as.numeric(NAI$RWA_T)
net_strong%v%"SDO_AE" <- as.numeric(NAI$SDO_AE)
net_strong%v%"SDO_D" <- as.numeric(NAI$SDO_D)

summary(net_strong, print.adj = FALSE) #check that it attached in the right format 

#pre-reg model 1####
ergm_model_preregFINALm1 <- ergm(net_strong ~ edges +
    esp(0) +
    esp(1) +
    esp(2) +
    esp(3)+  
    gwdegree(1.5, fixed=T) +
    nodematch('Gender') + 
    nodematch('Grade') +  
    nodematch('RWH') +  
    nodematch('ETH') +  
    absdiff('Income') +
    absdiff('pedu') +
    absdiff('RWA') + 
    absdiff('SDO') + 
    absdiff('PAT'),
    control=control.ergm(seed=40, parallel=6, MCMC.samplesize=50000, MCMC.interval=5000, MCMC.burnin=50000,  MCMLE.maxit=30))

#chech model fit diagnostics
mcmc.diagnostics(ergm_model_preregFINALm1)

modfit1 <- gof(ergm_model_preregFINALm1,
GOF = ~degree + distance + espartners + triadcensus,
burnin=1e+5, interval = 1e+5)

png(file="GOF_plot1.jpeg")
par(mfrow=c(3,2))
plot(modfit1,cex.axis=1.6,cex.label=1.6)
dev.off()


```

```{r Tables}
round_df <- function(x, digits) {
    # round all numeric variables
    # x: data frame 
    # digits: number of digits to round
    numeric_columns <- sapply(x, mode) == 'numeric'
    x[numeric_columns] <-  round(x[numeric_columns], digits)
    x
} #Round function

#Descriptive Table 1####
apa.cor.table(NAI, filename = "Table 1 (political network_sub).doc", table.number = 1,
              show.conf.interval=FALSE, landscape = TRUE)


#ERGM TABLES 2-4####
#--Exponentiate the values in put into WORD
Table1 <- broom::tidy(ergm_model_preregFINALm1, exponentiate=TRUE, conf.int=TRUE) #Export Model as tibble
Table1 <- round_df(Table1, 2) #Round to 2 decimal places 
Table1_ft <-   flextable::flextable(Table1) #create flextable to export to word
save_as_docx(Table1_ft, path="Table_1.docx") #export to word. 

Table2 <- broom::tidy(ergm_model_preregFINALm2, exponentiate=TRUE, conf.int=TRUE) #Export Model as tibble
Table2 <- round_df(Table2, 2) #Round to 2 decimal places 
Table2_ft <-   flextable::flextable(Table2) #create flextable to export to word
save_as_docx(Table2_ft, path="Table_2.docx") #export to word. 

Table3 <- broom::tidy(ergm_model_exp_small_final, exponentiate=TRUE, conf.int=TRUE) #Export Model as tibble
Table3 <- round_df(Table3, 2) #Round to 2 decimal places 
Table3_ft <-   flextable::flextable(Table3) #create flextable to export to word

save_as_docx(Table4_ft, path="Table_4.docx") #export to word.

```{r Figure 1}

#Network for Patriotism
node_colors2 <- rep("",213)
for(i in 1:213){
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"PAT")[i] < 6){
    node_colors2[i] <- "red"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"PAT")[i] < 5){
    node_colors2[i] <- "rosybrown1"}
    if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"PAT")[i] == 6){
    node_colors2[i] <- "red4"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"PAT")[i] == "999"){
    node_colors2[i] <- "grey"}
  
}
node_colors2

set.seed(100)
pdf(file="Network1.pdf")
plot.network(net_strong, # our network object
             vertex.col = node_colors2, # color nodes by patriotism
             displaylabels = F,
             xlab = "Early Adolescents' Peer Network \nBy Levels of Patriotism" # show the node names
             )
dev.off()

node_colors3 <- rep("",213)
for(i in 1:213){
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"RWA")[i] < 4.5){
    node_colors3[i] <- "deepskyblue3"}
    if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"RWA")[i] == 4.5){
    node_colors3[i] <- "lightskyblue1"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"RWA")[i] < 3.5){
    node_colors3[i] <- "grey93"}
    if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"RWA")[i] > 4.5){
    node_colors3[i] <- "blue4"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"RWA")[i] == "999"){
    node_colors3[i] <- "grey"}
  
}

hist(NDAT$RWA)

set.seed(100)
pdf(file="Network2.pdf")
plot.network(net_strong, # our network object
             vertex.col = node_colors3, # color nodes by patriotism
             displaylabels = F,
             xlab = "Early Adolescents' Peer Network \nBy Levels of RWA" # show the node names
             )
dev.off()

node_colors4 <- rep("",213)
for(i in 1:213){
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"IMM")[i] < 4.5){
    node_colors4[i] <- "darkseagreen1"}
    if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"IMM")[i] == 4.5){
    node_colors4[i] <- "darkseagreen1"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"IMM")[i] < 3){
    node_colors4[i] <- "grey93"}
    if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"IMM")[i] > 4.5){
    node_colors4[i] <- "darkgreen"}
  if(get.node.attr(net_strong,"IMM")[i] == "999"){
    node_colors4[i] <- "grey"}
  
}

hist(NDAT$IMM)

set.seed(100)
pdf(file="Network3.pdf")
plot.network(net_strong, # our network object
             vertex.col = node_colors4, # color nodes by patriotism
             displaylabels = F,
             xlab = "Early Adolescents' Peer Network \nBy Levels of Immigration Attitudes" # show the node names
             )
dev.off()

```{r Figure 1}
NAI2 <- NAI %>% select(.,RWA, SDO, PAT, ENV, IMM, IAP, SAP, Trump, Obama)

label <- c("RWA", "SDO", "PAT", "ENV", "IMM", "IAP", "SAP", "Trump", "Obama")

n  <- NAI2 %>% 
  gather(KEY, score, label) 

n$KEY[n$KEY == "PAT"] <- "Patriotism"
n$KEY[n$KEY == "ENV"] <- "Environmentalism"
n$KEY[n$KEY == "IMM"] <- "Immigration"
n$KEY[n$KEY == "IAP"] <- "Internal Att. Poverty"
n$KEY[n$KEY == "SAP"] <- "Social Att. Poverty"


n <- n %>%
  mutate(KEY = fct_relevel(KEY, levels = "Obama", "Trump", "Social Att. Poverty", "Internal Att. Poverty","Immigration", "Environmentalism", "Patriotism", "SDO", "RWA")) %>% 
  rename(Attitude=KEY)


fig1 <- ggplot(n, aes(x = score, y = Attitude, fill = stat(x))) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 3, rel_min_height = 0.01)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Intensity", option = "E") +
  theme_classic()

fig1a <- fig1 +  labs(title="Variability in Early Adolescents Political Attitudes", x="Attitude Intensity", y="Attitude") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
#        text = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5, 0, 0, 0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0, 5, 0, 0), "mm"))
  )

fig1a

fig1 <- ggplot(n, aes(x = score, y = Attitude, fill = stat(x))) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(
    jittered_points = TRUE, quantile_lines = TRUE, scale = 0.9, alpha = 0.7,
    vline_size = 1, vline_color = "red",
    point_size = 0.4, point_alpha = 1,
    position = position_raincloud(adjust_vlines = TRUE)
  )

cowplot::save_plot("plotridge.png", fig1a, base_width=6, base_height = 6)

```
